application_scenario.value: AI 数据中心受保护负载

confirmed_input.original_question: 为 CUSTOMER_X 在 REGION_ALPHA 评估 1MW UPS 与 800VDC，投产时间未知。

product_boundary.statement: Evidence supports specific UPS ratings (500-1250kW) and 800VDC architectural proposals, but lacks complete system integration data for the specific 1MW customer site.
product_boundary.decision_impact: Prevents final selection without resolving timing and constraint unknowns.

protected_load_boundary.statement: Vertiv evidence defines AI load transients (0-100% steps) and UPS control responses (Battery Shield, Input Power Smoothing).
protected_load_boundary.decision_impact: Defines the dynamic behavior the architecture must handle.

system_boundary.statement: NVIDIA states industry alignment is required on voltage ranges and safety; UPS specs exist but full system interoperability at 1MW is not proven.
system_boundary.decision_impact: System safety and interface standards remain a gating factor.

architecture_alternatives.label: Traditional UPS (Galaxy VXL)
architecture_alternatives.rationale: Product ratings (500-1250kW) cover the 1MW scope; efficiency and AI-load tolerance are documented, but battery aging risks under AI transients require mitigation.
architecture_alternatives.decision_impact: Viable if battery management strategies are confirmed for the specific load profile.

architecture_alternatives.label: NVIDIA 800VDC Architecture
architecture_alternatives.rationale: Proposed architecture scales beyond 1MW per rack, but requires industry alignment on interfaces and safety practices not yet completed.
architecture_alternatives.decision_impact: Cannot be selected for immediate deployment due to unresolved ecosystem requirements and timing.

application_fit.statement: UPS options have documented AI-load tolerance; 800VDC is a future roadmap item requiring ecosystem alignment.
application_fit.decision_impact: Fit depends on whether the project timeline aligns with 800VDC maturity or requires immediate UPS deployment.

no_fit_boundary.statement: 800VDC is currently unfit for immediate deployment where industry alignment on safety and interfaces is a mandatory prerequisite.
no_fit_boundary.decision_impact: Excludes 800VDC from immediate 'buy' decisions without further validation.

O1.title: Product Object Boundary
O1.decision: Product boundaries are defined by available UPS specs and 800VDC proposals, but system-level integration is unknown.

O2.title: Architecture Kill Precedence
O2.decision: 800VDC is killed for immediate deployment due to unresolved industry alignment on safety and interfaces.

O3.title: Application Behavior to Product Gate
O3.decision: AI load transients (0-100%) mandate UPS controls like Battery Shield or Input Power Smoothing.
O3.decision_impact: Filters product options to those with validated transient response.

O4.title: Benchmark Classification
O4.decision: Efficiency benchmarks exist for UPS (97.2%-99.4%); 800VDC lacks comparative operational benchmarks.

O5.title: System Boundary Test
O5.decision: System boundary test fails for 800VDC due to missing interface standards; passes for UPS subject to site analysis.
O5.decision_impact: Requires site-specific risk analysis for UPS.

O6.title: Market Entry Completeness
O6.decision: UPS is market-complete for 1MW; 800VDC is in roadmap/phased transition.
O6.decision_impact: Confirms UPS availability for immediate needs.

O7.title: Unknown-to-Decision Translation
O7.decision: Unknowns in timing and critical constraints directly block final architecture selection and funding release.

product_requirements.statement: System must manage 0% to 100% power steps internally without engaging batteries excessively.
product_requirements.decision_impact: Drives selection of UPS with advanced controls.

product_requirements.statement: Industry alignment on voltage ranges, connector interfaces, and safety practices is required for 800VDC.
product_requirements.decision_impact: Blocks 800VDC adoption until standards are resolved.

critical_metrics.name: UPS eConversion Efficiency
critical_metrics.decision_impact: Potential optimization mode for steady loads.

tradeoffs.benefit: Fast response to AI load transients using battery buffer.
tradeoffs.cost: Potential acceleration of battery aging due to micro-discharges.
tradeoffs.decision_impact: Necessitates control features like Battery Shield to mitigate wear.

risks.mitigation: Deploy UPS with Battery Shield or Input Power Smoothing controls.

risks.risk: Lack of industry alignment on safety and interfaces for 800VDC.
risks.mitigation: Defer 800VDC adoption or pursue pilot programs with explicit risk acceptance.

decision_gates.condition: Target timing for deployment is defined.
decision_gates.validation_action: Define project timeline and required commissioning date.
decision_gates.funding_effect: No funding released until timeline is confirmed.

decision_gates.validation_action: Conduct site survey to identify physical and regulatory constraints.
decision_gates.funding_effect: No funding released until constraints are documented.

validation_actions.action: Confirm target deployment date and phasing plan.
Identify and document critical site constraints (space, cooling, grid).
validation_actions.evidence_required: Site survey report and constraint log.

recommendation.decision: Proceed with UPS architecture evaluation for immediate needs; defer 800VDC decision.
recommendation.rationale: UPS products meet the 1MW scope with documented AI-load capabilities, while 800VDC lacks necessary ecosystem alignment for immediate deployment.
conditions: Target timing is confirmed to be immediate or near-term.
Battery management strategy is confirmed for AI transients.

required_action.action: Resolve target timing and critical constraints unknowns.

confidence.rationale: Strong evidence for component capabilities exists, but critical unknowns regarding timing and site constraints prevent a high-confidence final decision.

unresolved_unknowns.description: The target deployment date and phasing schedule are not defined.
unresolved_unknowns.decision_impact: Prevents selection between immediate UPS deployment and future 800VDC adoption.
unresolved_unknowns.required_validation_action: Define project timeline and required commissioning date.

unresolved_unknowns.description: Site-specific physical, regulatory, or operational constraints are not identified.
unresolved_unknowns.decision_impact: Prevents validation of system fit and safety compliance.
unresolved_unknowns.required_validation_action: Conduct site survey to identify physical and regulatory constraints.
